The '''SU-42RS Flashbind Aerial Reconnaissance Airspeeder''' was a class of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] utilized by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The SU-42RS was a militarized version of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[SU-40 airspeeder/Legends|SU-40 airspeeder]] and was built for high-altitude reconnaissance. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] SoroSuub engineers sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], would produce the SU-42RS in small numbers and distribute them to [[rebel cell]]s through the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="Lead By Example" />

==Characteristics==
The SU-42RS Flashbind Aerial Reconnaissance Airspeeder was a short wing-shaped [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] equipped with forward-mounted [[autoblaster]]s and a [[IN-780 ion turbofan engine/Legends|IN-780 ion turbofan engine]]. The IN-780 engine in the SU-42RS was tuned to allow for maximum speed and lifting thrust. Although it reduced the Flashbind's overall agility, it allowed the airspeeder to climb altitude quickly and outrun any enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] or [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. The airspeeder retained the two-position cockpit used by the SU-40 airspeeder but was slightly largered and protected by anti-splinter armor.<ref name="Lead By Example" />

==History==
The SU-42RS airspeeder was utilized by the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] which served in the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Lead By Example" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], SoroSuub Corporation engineers who sympathized with the Rebel Alliance secretly distributed the airspeeders to the Alliance through channels on the black market.<ref name="Lead By Example" />

==Behind the scenes==
The SU-42RS Flashbind Aerial Reconnaissance Airspeeder was mentioned in ''[[Lead by Example]]'',<ref name="Lead By Example" /> a [[2016]]<ref name="Join the Top Ranks">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2016/2/4/join-the-top-ranks|text=Join the Top Ranks}}</ref> sourcebook for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Lead By Example" />
